notes.title: Grim Diary: ReWrite (Big Changes)
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/e508fdb9a2eaca89a2983083f7e2aaf357a79161.png"][/img][/p][p]This is a revision of the project grim diary. The last patch has been a while because of the big changes still in development. The project has not been abandoned, it’s constantly being developed. It’s a big step~up and changes compared to the previous direction.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]No More Modes [/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/a6149d759a604cb2b53b89637ddba1f91b04b215.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/83a93a1cdefd4a049a6819ef4fb9344e49b2ccca.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/0810a7f4de00c0dd01c0c24a69d6d08590348c67.png"][/img]Instead of modes it will be added as part of the world going to explore. Everything now revolve around exploring.All the modes now will be added in this new open world. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Changes to Character Selection[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/daa166887a68f16ef71d0f6febff785567bdd0d3.png"][/img][/p][p]Instead of the character selection player will be modifying the team through the world itself.[/p][p]New additional characters will be recruitable to the party. Default characters will be Emi and Eli.[/p][p][/p][h2]Defeat Condition[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/0e73d3d9e14c518f85ad2b2addcd7423a533f1a0.png"][/img][/p][p]Will spawn to Save Point which can be found inside the kabo’s Village.[/p][p][/p][h3]Battle/Encounter[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/1403b473d28758687705a12bd8558f6f6ce8738b.png"][/img][/p][p]The battle system does not change much.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/d5a86d8dd371756bf6a807debbec45a0c6af9919.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for the support.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]If you’re interested to see the constant update and behind the scenes.[/p][p]Follow me on:[/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/LepusGameDev"]https://www.facebook.com/LepusGameDev[/url][/p][p][url="https://x.com/BlackMagicaRao"]https://x.com/BlackMagicaRao[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: New Level Design Preview
notes.content:
[h3]New Level Design Preview[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/5661c5614b84e8a7f733a42a4bb7e384ac3fa8c2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/f54757052890012e12a2bf83855e5be0a2c6394b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/a50e30d787d67baaeed0f34980e9c98dd1b11a15.png"][/img][/p][p]These major changes will take a while but it’s a guaranteed new experience. A new flesh out take on grim diary.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/13efc29ae976f237c1576dad88a0c713e6c47870.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Retelling Story[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/2601d9e8c5864966ecf83ad5cc79f400680bb84e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/c2a2bcf357d590f4d64bd15012e1688538ec2d52.png"][/img][/p][p]With the new changes in level design the current story is not perfectly fit anymore. Some changes need to be made. But the whole premise is still untouched.[/p][p]

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/5535f21636556be4fa8ed42a85b80ff20717abb4.png"][/img][/p][p]
Grim Diary is heading in a new direction. And more open world oriented features. Bit by bit will make it come true.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Level Design Rework
notes.content: [p]Grim Diary ~ Level Design Rework [/p][p]Instead of choosing a path through UI. It will change to Emi exploring around discovering hidden passages. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/e76009d6c5ebb0761011c1380206c6666303dbf8.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/3201527e0821df67d2cbcd3da2e130058d9fc423.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/86ad4b11425302b0c5d3c171f5edaa34ab0339d4.png"][/img][/p][p]Instead of keep pushing new story chapters i think it will amount to nothing if the level design is not decent enough.the current design does not fit with the vision I have for this game. That's why the changes. And believe this will improve the game and makes the player feels like part of the grim diary world.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Out now version 0.01.0.06v
notes.content:
[p]Improved UI[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/44266ab1601e0b284c5325c031b0b652a8b36e7e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/13efc29ae976f237c1576dad88a0c713e6c47870.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Fast Forward Feature[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/b7b6bfebb262be85ecb284cb5dac49af093ff7de.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Toggle[/b] ~ Clicking the UI Change the phase permanently[/p][p][b]Hold Space or Hold Mouse right button[/b] ~ Temporary fast forward.[/p][p] 
This feature is added for more control and enhances experience by being able to do strategies better and make the phasing much faster.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/13efc29ae976f237c1576dad88a0c713e6c47870.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hand Limit[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/60aa654133ea0e1d91d67cda8bddefbca65fdf49.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hand limit is not indicated before and leads to confusing gameplay.[/p][p]Now it’s set to Maximum of 6 cards on hand.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/13efc29ae976f237c1576dad88a0c713e6c47870.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Adjusting Gameplay Stats[/b][/p][p][/p][p]-Remove the default 50% Action meter at the start of the encounter.[/p][p]-Remove Extra Draw after shuffling[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/13efc29ae976f237c1576dad88a0c713e6c47870.png"][/img]
[b]Fixed:[/b][/p][p]
Fix Action Meter lagging now much more smoother.[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/13efc29ae976f237c1576dad88a0c713e6c47870.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Emi Skills[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Remove Interfere Effect to  Ethereal Arrow[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618553/5e5fa59564d0dd39630ccbd8d92107c057dbad39.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
